settings.question: What’s included with the Crawley 600mm vanity?
settings.answer: The Crawley 600mm includes a floor-standing vanity cabinet, ceramic basin and chrome pop-up waste. All necessary fittings and assembly instructions are also included.

settings.question: What are the dimensions of the 600mm model?
settings.answer: The overall dimensions are 600mm wide × 388mm deep × 800mm high.

settings.question: Does the basin have a tap hole?
settings.answer: Yes. The ceramic basin has one pre-drilled 35mm tap hole.

settings.question: Is the vanity supplied assembled?
settings.answer: The cabinet requires straightforward self-assembly. Instructions and cabinet fittings are included.

settings.question: Is the cabinet suitable for a bathroom environment?
settings.answer: Yes. It has a painted moisture-resistant finish designed for normal bathroom use.

settings.question: Will the cabinet and basin arrive together?
settings.answer: They may arrive in separate parcels because of their weight. Tracking is supplied for each parcel.

settings.question: What happens if my order arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Photograph the packaging and damaged item, then contact our team within 48 hours so we can help resolve it.

settings.question: Can I return the product if I change my mind?
settings.answer: Yes. Unused products in their original packaging can be returned within 30 days, subject to the returns policy.

settings.question: Will this work with pipes coming through the floor?
settings.answer: Yes, the Crawley vanity can work with floor pipework. There is space inside the cabinet for standard floor connections.

settings.question: Can the internal shelf be adjusted or removed?
settings.answer: The internal shelf can be adapted during installation where plumbing access requires it.

settings.question: Which tap do you recommend for this basin?
settings.answer: Choose a compatible single-hole mono basin mixer.
